summary: End-to-end testing of Church Treasury app (Providence Baptist Church). Backend pytest suite (24 tests) covers auth, dashboard, lookups, transactions CRUD (income/expense/transfer), filters, Treasurer's Report math + PDF, settings CRUD across all tabs, and admin-only user management. All 24 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke test via Playwright validated login (invalid+valid), dashboard (3 accounts + fund balances + recent activity), transaction creation (expense with check# & memo persisted + visible in list), Reports page (presets, include-category/funds, Generate produces exact reconciliation values 76,880.68 / 3,955.74 / 762.93 / 80,073.49), and Settings tabs all present (accounts/funds/categories/payees/coa/church/users).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (console warning, a11y nit, non-blocking)

Header shows 'Grace Treasury' as app brand while CHURCH_NAME env is 'Providence Baptist Church'. Report body correctly shows Providence Baptist Church. Confirm with product owner whether header brand should also derive from church settings.

action_items: Optional: add aria-describedby or <DialogDescription> to TransactionDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
Optional: consider sourcing header brand from church settings (church_name) instead of hardcoded 'Grace Treasury' for consistency with the Treasurer's Report.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 813 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, crud factory, transactions, reports/pdf, settings, seed) for maintainability.
Report build_report() loops `signed_amount_for_account` with await inside a sync loop over DB cursor — fine for small volumes but could be optimised with aggregation at scale.
/api/transactions DELETE returns 200 even when txn_id doesn't exist (idempotent delete) — acceptable but tests expecting 404 would fail; current tests align.
Non-admin role check is correctly enforced at API level (verified via test_non_admin_cannot_manage_users).

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Low risk here since auth uses Bearer tokens, but tighten origins before production.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; relied on existing seed (3 accounts, 3 funds, categories/payees/COA, 9 sample June 2026 txns). Test-created rows are deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend validated end-to-end. Note: Download PDF button only renders AFTER clicking Generate (conditional). Use data-testid btn-download-pdf post-generate. Account checkboxes default to all selected on Reports page. TransactionDialog bank-account select has 3 options rendered as [role=option]; use force=True clicks inside dialog.
